name: Cron
description: A scheduled job that executes a Bot on a recurring schedule.

properties.name: onBehalfOf
properties.short: The membership on whose behalf the job runs
properties.definition: The project membership whose identity and access policy the scheduled job assumes when it runs.

properties.name: parameters
properties.definition: Parameters passed to the target as input each time the scheduled job runs.

properties.name: cron[x]

properties.definition: A schedule for the job to be executed, as a cron expression.

properties.name: target[x]
